trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

steps.purpose: Express intent to see an orthopaedic doctor.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मुझे orthopaedic doctor से मिलना है। First time here.

steps.purpose: Greet and ask for patient ID.
steps.text: नमस्ते। मैं इसमें आपकी मदद कर सकती हूँ। क्या आपके पास पहले से कोई patient ID है?

steps.purpose: Provide patient ID.
steps.text: हाँ, मेरे पास एक ID है, PT-1003.

steps.purpose: Ask for verification factors.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। आगे बढ़ने से पहले, क्या आप verification के लिए अपना नाम और date of birth बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide name and date of birth.
steps.text: मेरा नाम रमेश है और date of birth 1st January 1980 है।

steps.purpose: Verify caller identity.
Return verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and state intent to check record.
steps.text: शुक्रिया रमेश जी। मैं आपका record check कर लेती हूँ।

steps.purpose: Look up patient record.
Return patient record details.
Inform patient they are unregistered and cannot book yet.
steps.text: रमेश जी, आपका patient ID PT-1003 system में है, पर आप fully registered नहीं हैं। Outpatient consultation book करने के लिए registration पूरा होना ज़रूरी है।

steps.purpose: Ask for clarification on domain terminology.
steps.text: Outpatient consultation क्या होता है? सीधे शब्दों में बताएं, मुझे क्या करना होगा?

steps.purpose: Explain domain term in plain language.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिए। इसका मतलब है कि doctor से मिलने के लिए आपको पहले hospital आकर अपना नाम register करवाना होगा।

steps.purpose: Confirm understanding and ask for doctor availability.
steps.text: Hospital आकर नाम register करवाना होगा? ठीक है। पर क्या आप बता सकते हैं कि orthopaedic doctor कब available हैं?

steps.purpose: Prompt for missing mandatory argument 'days_ahead'.
steps.text: ज़रूर, मैं check कर लेती हूँ। Availability check करने के लिए, आप कितने दिन आगे का schedule देखना चाहते हैं? 3, 7, या 14 days?

steps.purpose: Specify timeframe with an STT error.
steps.text: अगले तीन दिन का देख लीजिए।

steps.purpose: Clarify timeframe due to STT error.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिए, मुझे ठीक से सुनाई नहीं दिया। क्या आप 3 days की बात कर रहे हैं?

steps.purpose: Confirm the timeframe.
steps.text: हाँ, 3 days का check करिए।

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for 3 days.
Return availability result for 3 days.
Inform user that no slots are available in 3 days.
steps.text: अगले 3 दिनों में orthopaedics department में कोई slot available नहीं है।

steps.purpose: Request to check for 7 days instead.
steps.text: कोई slot नहीं है? तो फिर एक काम करिए, 7 days का check करिए।

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for 7 days.
Return availability result for 7 days.
Provide available slot details.
steps.text: 7 days के अंदर Dr. Sharma available हैं। उनका slot Monday को 10:00 AM का है, और consultation fee 800 rupees है।

steps.purpose: Repeat details and request booking.
steps.text: Monday 10:00 AM और 800 rupees fee? ठीक है, आप यह book कर दीजिए मेरे लिए।

steps.purpose: Refuse booking due to lack of registration.
steps.text: मैं यह slot book नहीं कर सकती क्योंकि आपका registration पूरा नहीं है। आपको पहले hospital आकर registration करना होगा, उसके बाद ही booking हो पाएगी।

steps.purpose: Accept the requirement to register in person.
steps.text: Oh, बिना registration के book नहीं होगा। ठीक है, मैं Monday को जल्दी आकर पहले register कर लूँगा।

steps.purpose: Confirm next steps and offer further help.
steps.text: जी हाँ, registration के बाद आप वहीं desk से appointment ले सकते हैं। क्या मैं आपकी किसी और तरह से मदद कर सकती हूँ?

steps.purpose: Decline further help and end call.
steps.text: नहीं, बस इतना ही जानना था। Thank you.

ir.terminal_condition: Patient informed that registration must be completed in person before booking.
